title: 人混みなんて問題じゃないわ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo and I are out together, when…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's that crowd of people up to?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, could it be this? The aquarium's billboard says they're going to be introducing a new baby seal.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: It must be a fairly rare event to have attracted so many people.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Oh, no, I don't think so…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: A king doesn't mingle with a crowd! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Urk! W-well, of course I don't! It's so difficult to move around, and, you know… um…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: It's so crowded that we won't be able to see anything even if we got inside anyway!
choice_data_list: In that case, we can weave our way through the crowd.
In that case, we just have to push our way through.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Weave our way through?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ahh, you mean we need to plot a course through this sea of people. That's not a bad idea.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Well, that and a king never backs down from a challenge! Let's give it a try!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ah! The crowd is trying to carry us away! Stay on your toes, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! We made it all the way through without being caught up in the crowd!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: How about that! No one can keep up with my speed!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …Wait, why did we come to the aquarium again?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo was so focused on getting to the front of the crowd that she completely missed seeing the baby seal.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Push our way through?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I suppose I can't run away from all of my problems… and I would hate being seen doing so.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I must persevere and open a way forward with my majestic presence, even if I get caught in the middle of everyone!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Very well, Trainer! Let's part the crowd and force our way through!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: A-all right… The baby seal is right on the other side of that group…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Here I go! Let the grand spectacle of me marching bravely forth be forever emblazoned in your memory!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Um, excuse me! C-could I possibly slip by here?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Nnngh! It's so cramped! I'm being crushed! But I won't give up!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant… I somehow managed… to see the seal…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I didn't realize I was willing to work this hard just to see a baby animal…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite the stress of the crowd, King Halo pushes on and achieves her goal.
